subject.description: Very attractive young Spanish woman taking a front-camera selfie with her arm extended, camera at eye level. The phone is NOT visible in the frame and she is looking straight at the camera, not at the screen.
subject.skin: clean and healthy skin, no acne, no blemishes, but with real skin texture (no studio retouching, no plastic look)

expression.face: total shock: eyes wide open, mouth open, eyebrows raised
expression.feeling: she has just found out something unbelievable

framing.shot: vertical 9:16 selfie, head and shoulders, face taking most of the frame

photography.look: real phone selfie, not a photographer's shot: phone flash, slight grain, slight motion blur
photography.avoid: no studio lighting, no artificial background blur, no cinematic look, no model posing, no beauty filter

clothing.style: everyday clothes: t-shirt, top, sweatshirt or hoodie

output.no_text: no text, no logos, no watermarks
